body:
Adds `research/categorical-scores`, the multiclass follow-up to `tangent-log`. It gives exact regrets, exact worst-case regrets and local curvature for the Brier, spherical and log scores on the K-simplex. Spherical gives exactly √K times Brier's incentive per payment range at a uniform truth. Both bounded scores nearly ignore a dropped rare class. Includes 6 tests, an experiment script with results, a white paper, and updates to the root README and the portfolio page.
